layman_headline: Market is ripping higher but everything looks overextended — patience is the play right now.
layman_explanation: Bitcoin just surged 23% in a week and dragged most altcoins up 30-70%. Our XRP position entered at $1.56 and is currently down 5.1% but still well above our $1.30 stop-loss. The entire market is in 'Greed' mode with most coins overbought after massive rallies. Chasing these moves now carries high risk of buying near a short-term top.
layman_action: Hold your current XRP position and let it play out — it's within normal volatility and above stop-loss. Don't chase the rally. Wait for a pullback before adding new positions.
expert_reasoning: The entire crypto market just experienced a massive short squeeze with BTC futures OI collapsing, driving a broad 20-50%+ rally across the board. While the trend is clearly bullish and the CryptoSlate headline about a $215B altcoin rally resting on BTC holding structure is constructive, every swing candidate is severely extended. PUMP has RSI 86 (dangerously overbought), XRP/ZEC/MON/LIT all gained 40-70% in 7 days. BTC dominance at 59.7% is still high, meaning alt outperformance may be fragile. Our existing XRP position at -5.1% is within normal range after a 48.7% weekly surge — the pullback from $1.56 to $1.48 is healthy consolidation. SOL is the best watchlist candidate given ETF inflows, but entering any position at these levels violates swing trading discipline.
risk_factors: Market-wide retracement after 20-50% weekly rallies could hit all positions simultaneously
BTC dominance at 59.7% remains elevated — altcoin rallies may stall or reverse quickly
Greed sentiment (74) trending higher increases probability of a sharp correction
watch_list: SOL price action — watch for pullback to $90-93 zone as potential clean entry
XRP holding above $1.40 support — critical for maintaining our current position thesis
BTC reaction at $80K psychological resistance — rejection could trigger broad altcoin selloff
market_context: Bitcoin just completed a historic 25% weekly advance driven by a massive short squeeze, pushing the market into Greed territory. The rally is powerful but nearly every asset is extended, making new entries high-risk until consolidation occurs.
context_banner: Post-squeeze euphoria has markets overextended — discipline demands waiting for consolidation before deploying new capital.

key_signals.description: Bitcoin short squeeze with collapsing futures OI explains the violent 25% weekly rally — this is a positioning-driven move, not organic, increasing retracement risk.
CryptoSlate reports $215B altcoin rally depends on BTC holding reclaimed structure — constructive but conditional, suggesting caution on alt entries.
Fear & Greed at 74 (Greed) and trending up from weekly avg of 66 — historically a mixed signal (56% win rate), suggesting elevated correction probability.
PUMP RSI at 86 is deeply overbought; while no RSI data available for other candidates, 40-70% weekly gains across the board suggest similar overbought conditions market-wide.
Solana ETFs extending growth streak to 5 days with year's biggest inflows provides a strong fundamental catalyst for SOL, making it the top watchlist candidate on a pullback.
